goal: Tell a new contributor, in the README, the one command to run before pushing and what it checks.
inputs: package.json defines npm run check; scripts/check.mjs is what it runs.
docs/checks.md describes the check in detail; link to it rather than repeating it.

acceptance_criteria.statement: README.md has a short section titled 'Before you push' that says to run npm run check, lists what it checks (format, lint, typecheck, tests and build) and links to docs/checks.md.

evidence.steps: Open README.md on the PR branch and read the 'Before you push' section.
evidence.expected: The section names npm run check, lists format, lint, typecheck, tests and build, and its link to docs/checks.md opens that file.
